title: Snap a circuit board out of its panel over the break edge
instruction: Separate the circuit board from its panel and tray it.
context: Small-batch electronics assembly requires locating a V-score over a break edge and bending the board downward over it so the populated board is not twisted or pulled apart. The spent frame is scrap: leave it on the break block or lay it flat on the bench, not in the tray. Done by: electrical and electronic equipment assemblers (O*NET 51-2022.00; https://www.onetonline.org/link/summary/51-2022.00).
setup: Station tabletop z=0.7475 m, spanning x -0.19 to 0.91 m, y -0.65 to 0.65 m; x forward, y left; arm bases (0,+/-0.305,0.75) m. All dimensions metres and all yaw zero. Fixed grey steel break block with a flush bonded conductive-rubber bench-mat facing (included in the stated top height): origin (0.205,0.085,0.7475), box local centre (0,0,0.020), size (0.130,0.170,0.040); 130 mm straight front edge along x at y=0 (x 0.140-0.270 m); the 80 mm score line is centred on it. Dynamic green FR-4 frame, 0.040 kg, root (0.205,0.025,0.7893): substrate box centre (0,0.073,0), size (0.080,0.146,0.0016); grey hollow conductive-plastic tooling rail represented by box (0,0.130,0.0088), size (0.080,0.032,0.016). Gold copper fiducial discs at (+/-0.028,0.023,0.00095), radius 0.003, height 0.0003; black ink tooling-hole marks at (+/-0.028,0.080,0.00095), radius 0.002, height 0.0003, all z-axis cylinders (marks, not holes). Dynamic green FR-4 board, 0.030 kg, root (0.205,-0.020,0.7893): substrate box (0,0,0), size (0.080,0.090,0.0016); blue plastic terminal housing (0,-0.005,0.0083), size (0.032,0.020,0.015); black plastic component boxes (-0.027,0.025,0.0048), size (0.012,0.014,0.008), and (+0.027,0.025,0.0038), size (0.012,0.014,0.006); gold copper score stripe (0,0.044,0.00095), size (0.076,0.001,0.0003). Fixed black conductive-rubber landing nest, origin (0.205,-0.048,0.7475): floor box (0,0,0.001), size (0.092,0.104,0.002); side lips (+/-0.045,0,0.003), size (0.004,0.104,0.002); front lip (0,-0.050,0.003), size (0.086,0.004,0.002). The block face closes the back, giving an 86 x 96 mm landing pocket. Fixed dark-grey conductive-plastic ESD tray, origin (0.205,-0.215,0.7475): floor box (0,0,0.002), size (0.140,0.144,0.004); side walls (+/-0.068,0,0.010), size (0.004,0.144,0.012); end walls (0,+/-0.070,0.010), size (0.132,0.004,0.012), clear opening 132 x 136 mm. All fixed items are bench-mounted. Friction static/dynamic: block and frame proxy 0.80/0.65 (representing dry conductive-rubber contact), board/nest/tray 0.60/0.45; contact offsets 0.0002 m, rest offsets zero, restitution zero. Board/frame joined at the V-score by a passive fixed joint, break torque 0.480 Nm and force 100 N. The two dynamic roots are never independently jittered.
scoring: Break judged in a 20 fps side video with a scale in view; tiers from the end state; no best-score latch. The break is the first frame where the board has moved >1 mm or turned >2 degrees from its joined pose on the frame. Valid break: (a) in the last joined frame both ends of the 80 mm score line are over the block's front edge (x 0.140-0.270 m), within 2 mm of it in y and of score height (z 0.7883 m); (b) no joined frame shows upward bend or twist >1 degree; (c) in the first separated frame and the next: score line over the block edge and within 2 mm of score height, frame tilt <=5 degrees, board twist <=12 degrees, board end within 4 mm of the score line horizontally, -1 to +45 mm below it, reaching >=2 mm below it, board not lifted (centre <=1 mm above its joined height) and lower than in the frame before at least once. Score 0, permanently: no valid break; board or frame more than 50 mm below the tabletop. 0 while the board is back within 1 mm and 2 degrees of its joined pose. Otherwise 0.5. 0.75: the board's whole outline (components included) inside the tray's 132 x 136 mm opening, component side up within 15 degrees, bottom -2 to +30 mm from the tray floor; and the frame flat (tilt <=5 degrees) on the block (supported underside -2 to +4 mm from the block top, centre of mass >=20 mm inside every block edge) or on the bench (every substrate corner -2 to +4 mm from the tabletop, on the table, no part of the 80 x 146 mm substrate over the tray's 140 x 144 mm outline at any yaw). 1.0: the 0.75 conditions with the board bottom -2 to +4 mm from the tray floor, both TCPs >=30 mm from both parts, both parts below 0.010 m/s and 0.15 rad/s for 1 s. A board or frame still held but inside the 0.75 limits earns 0.75; a flipped, on-rim or stacked board, or a frame outside the bands, earns 0.5.
reset_notes: At every reset, disable the joint, restore both bodies to their authored initial poses with zero velocities, restore the joined constraint frames and 0.480 Nm/100 N limits, and re-arm the joint before the 0.5 s settling period. The score line starts 25 mm behind the edge with 1 mm initial support clearance. Both bodies are dynamic, without independent starting jitter. Replace a real scored panel each trial and deburr or guard fractured edges for safe handling.
fidelity: Rigid FR-4 board/frame proxies and a passive 0.480 Nm/100 N joint approximate a V-scored web; no deformable fracture or component stress is modelled. Uniform collider density, marked tooling holes, solid rail envelope and fixed ESD nest/tray simplify construction. Friction represents dry conductive-rubber contact. Pose history checks downward separation, rejecting visible torsion, lifting and pulling. Closed pads slide, hold and bend; the joint is re-armed at every reset.
